title: Spot the risky settings
prompt: This is a router settings summary. Tap every risky setting, then press Check.

segments.why: An open network has no encryption. Anyone nearby can join and watch unprotected traffic.
A default admin password is widely known and lets others change your settings.
WPA3 is a strong, current security standard.
A long, unique phrase is a good Wi-Fi password.

segments.text: Router software last updated 4 years ago
segments.why: Old firmware may contain known security holes. Keep it updated.

segments.text: Guest network turned on for visitors
segments.why: A guest network keeps visitors away from your own devices.
